text: The gardener lied! Here's how you could tell.
He said: I heard the thunder... then I saw the lightning.
Impossible! Light travels nearly a million times faster than sound.
You always see the flash first. Then the boom.
One of you asked: how did the maid make tea with no power?
Great question! A gas stove works in a blackout.
Did you get it? New case this Saturday. Subscribe so you don't miss it!
